subject: Post-call recap: token budget snapshot & service allocation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: token budget snapshot & service allocation

Claire — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and explicit asks so we can lock the MAP and pricing proposal: 

Call highlights (my take):
- AtlasAI expects heavy conversational usage for search-summarization and follow-on clarification flows (demo looked great).
- Initial pilot: 3 months, targeting production rollout by Q4.
- Preliminary throughput: ~1.0–1.5B tokens/month after week 1 ramp (you mentioned 1.2B as a mid estimate).
- Model mix we discussed: chat generation (dominant), embeddings for retrieval, and a small rerank path for high-value queries.

Asks / confirmation items:
1) Final expected ramped monthly tokens (pick one): 800M | 1.2B | 1.5B — please confirm the number you want us to base pricing on.
2) Target unit economics: you mentioned wanting to hold average target spend around $750–$1,200 per 1M tokens — can you confirm a hard target (e.g., $900/1M)?
3) Proposed per-model split (we'll use this to simulate cost and latency):
   - Chat (completion + context): 60%
   - Embeddings (indexing + query): 30%
   - Rerank/scoring: 10%
   If this looks off, tell us your preferred split.
4) SLA / capacity ask: will you require dedicated pools for pilot or is hosted shared fine? (If dedicated, we can give a better committed-rate price.)

Next steps I propose:
- Jordan/Rishi to produce two pricing scenarios (hosted shared vs. dedicated reserve) with per-model unit pricing and total monthly cost based on your confirmed token volume.
- Marissa to prepare a 1-page MAP with milestones and handoff dates.
- Claire to confirm the three bullets above and share any procurement cadence.

I've attached an initial pricing workbook so you can play with the numbers (redwood-initial-pricing.xlsx).

Thanks — I’ll aim to get the scenarios to you by EOD tomorrow once you confirm the token anchor and $/1M target.

—
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.com]

Attachment: redwood-initial-pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet stub — model/unit rows + scenario tabs)

From: Claire Zhang <claire@atlasai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: AtlasAI Procurement <procure@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:37:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: token budget snapshot & service allocation

Jordan — thanks for the thorough recap. Quick answers below: 

1) Token anchor: please use 1.2B tokens/month for the pricing scenarios. That is the most realistic steady-state after pilot.
2) Target $/1M: our internal stakeholders would prefer to see a base target of $850 per 1M tokens as the budgeted baseline; anything below $800 will be a win and anything above $1,100 stretches the ROI case.
3) Model split: the initial ramp will skew embeddings higher as we seed the retrieval layer, so adjust the split to:
   - Chat: 55%
   - Embeddings: 35%
   - Rerank: 10%

SLA: For pilot, hosted shared is acceptable. If we move to pilot->prod (after month 2), we'll want to revisit dedicated reserved capacity.

Procurement note: Procurement needs a 60-day standard review window. We'll loop in legal after pricing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Claire Zhang
Head of Product 
AtlasAI
claire@atlasai.com

On Tue, May 12, 2026 at 3:10 PM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Claire — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and explicit asks so we can lock the MAP and pricing proposal: ...

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire@atlasai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: token budget snapshot & service allocation

Claire — perfect, thanks for confirming. Based on 1.2B tokens/month and your $850/1M target, we've sketched two scenarios (attached):

Scenario A — Hosted (shared):
- Assumes smart batching + global prefix caching; default model routing (chat:55 / embed:35 / rerank:10).
- Estimated blended unit price: $0.89 per 1K tokens (blended), which maps to ~$890 per 1M tokens.
- Estimated monthly cost: ~$1,068,000.
- Pros: fastest to start, no infra commitments.
- Cons: slightly higher unit cost; potential variability under extreme burst.

Scenario B — Dedicated reserve (3-month commit):
- Dedicated GPU pools with reserved throughput and quantization profile.
- Estimated blended unit price: $0.74 per 1K tokens => ~$740 per 1M tokens.
- Estimated monthly cost: ~$888,000.
- Pros: better unit economics (within your $850 target), predictable latency.
- Cons: commit + 3-month billing cadence.

Per-model breakouts (monthly token volumes at 1.2B):
- Chat: 660M tokens (55%)
- Embeddings: 420M tokens (35%)
- Rerank: 120M tokens (10%)

Edge notes:
- If you offload heavy embedding index generation to asynchronous batches during off-peak, effective embedding unit costs can fall another ~8–12% (we modeled this in the spreadsheet).
- Rishi: see my ask below on quantization/latency tradeoffs for dedicated vs. shared paths.

Next actions:
- Marissa will circulate a one-page MAP and a clean table comparing the two scenarios (attached: MAP-v1.docx).
- Please confirm if procurement wants us to model the cost assuming a 3-month commit for Scenario B. If yes, we’ll include amended PO-friendly language.

Attaching: MAP-v1.docx (MAP draft), redwood-initial-pricing.xlsx (updated with scenarios).

—
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MAP-v1.docx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Claire Zhang <claire@atlasai.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: token budget snapshot & service allocation

Thanks team — quick technical + pricing notes from infra side: 

1) Quantization & model family: if AtlasAI is comfortable with an 8-bit quantized chat model for a portion of the chat traffic (we can route lower-confidence/less-sensitive queries to that variant), we can knock another ~10–12% off the blended unit cost in Scenario B. I modeled a split: 40% full-precision chat / 15% q8 chat / 35% embeddings / 10% rerank; that gets the blended price closer to your $850 target without a larger commit.

2) Dedicated reserve sizing: for 1.2B tokens/month with your mix, a small dedicated pool (2–3 A100-equivalent workers with burst) should cover steady-state throughput with headroom. I attached a quick capacity-estimate.csv with the sim numbers.

3) Next step from infra: we can provide a perf snapshot (latency p50/p95) for the proposed routing and q8 mix — it’s small but helpful for your SRE. I’ll produce that if Claire wants it.

Jordan/Marissa: I recommend we present a 2-slide technical appendix to procurement showing the q8 option and rollback plan.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity-estimate.csv (CSV stub — worker counts & throughput sims)
